title: A local stalk is the limit of affine neighbourhoods
statement: For any scheme S and point s, there is a directed preorder indexing affine open neighbourhoods of s and an affine-transition inverse system D of their affine spectra, a limiting cone c, and an isomorphism Spec(O_S,s)≅c. Each stage is identified with its affine open subscheme and every limit projection composes to the canonical map Spec(O_S,s)→S. No reducedness or irreducibility is assumed. proof.text: Affine neighbourhoods of s are cofiltered: refine any intersection by an affine neighbourhood. Their opposite is cofinal among the neighbourhoods defining the stalk colimit. Restrict this colimit to the affine neighbourhoods; Spec carries the resulting ring colimit to a scheme limit. The order-dual equivalence converts this to the directed-set convention. The germ maps and the affine chart isomorphisms give the projection equations.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_neighbourhood_stalk_limit (X : Scheme.{u}) (x : X) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : Preorder I) (_ : IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)) (_ : Nonempty I)
      (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
      (e : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x) ≅ c.pt),
      Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧ (∀ i, IsAffine (D.obj i)) ∧
      (∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)) ∧
      ∀ i : I, ∃ (U : X.Opens) (_ : x ∈ U) (_ : IsAffineOpen U)
        (eU : D.obj (op i) ≅ U.toScheme),
        e.hom ≫ c.π.app (op i) ≫ eU.hom ≫ U.ι = X.fromSpecStalk x
